dog.description_text:
This pet is available only through ACC New Hope partners. To adopt or foster, please complete the pre-screener form below. Inquiries sent directly to ACC will not receive a response.

Pre-Screener Form

Faith arrived at MACC as an owner surrender. In her previous home Faith has a history of fighting with the resident dog that results in multiple bites and scratches. The owner states that they were not able to break up these fights and that the dogs have given each other multiple wounds. While in care, Faith has been observed to be highly rope reactive, noted to jump up high and bite the leash. This behavior is very difficult to redirect. Due to the detailed behavior we recommend an experienced adult only, single pet home.
dog.name: Faith
